# Server only environment variables. One name per line.
# The client bundle check fails if any of these values appears in the built client output.
#
# The web application has no server and no credentials of its own. The planned names below
# are listed in advance so the first commit that introduces one is already covered; the
# check reports "skip" for a name whose value is not set in the running environment.
#
# In use today by the one live integration, scripts/prospect-scanner (a local CLI, never
# bundled for the browser):
RAPIDAPI_KEY

# Planned per docs/BUILD_SPEC.md and docs/SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md:
DATABASE_URL
SESSION_SECRET
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
OPENAI_API_KEY
GEMINI_API_KEY
PERPLEXITY_API_KEY
DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD
YELP_API_KEY
GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY
